title: Integrability of an upper-tail function
statement:
Let $
u$ be a finite measure on $\mathbb{R}$, and let $t\in\mathbb{R}$. Suppose that $z\mapsto\max(z-t,0)$ is integrable with respect to $
u$. Then the function $u\mapsto
u((t+u,\infty))$ is integrable on $(0,\infty)$.
